paragraphs: The stained glass tells Bible stories through people, animals, plants and symbols. The 1928 church guide describes a sequence from Creation to the lives and deaths of the disciples.

The guide credits A. L. Brink with the pictures in the side and south-end windows. It credits Alfred E. Floegel with the large memorial window above the Communion table. These are historical glass credits, separate from the modern photographs and coloring drawings.
The present church building was dedicated on 28 October 1928. Its 1928-2028 anniversary marks a century of this building. The congregation began in 1835.
Descriptions distinguish visible details from historical identifications. Locations from the old guide are historical descriptions; they have not all been checked against the church today.
